records.name: Average gross borrower income for approved first-home buyers vs property investors
records.also_known_as: Borrower Gross Income (BGI) mean across approved FHB & investor applications (RBNZ C41)
records.source_full: Reserve Bank of New Zealand — Residential mortgage borrower gross income (BGI) (Table C41)
records.source_series_ids: Sum(Band Total Gross Income) ÷ Sum(Band Implied Borrowers) across TDTI bands
records.data_type: HLF-derived band-weighted mean from official RBNZ Table C41 bands
records.definition: The band-weighted mean annual gross borrower income across approved New Zealand first-home buyer mortgage applications and property investor applications, derived by HLF from RBNZ Table C41's Debt-to-Income bands.
records.formula: Sum(Band Total Gross Income [$m]) ÷ Sum(Band Total Gross Income [$m] ÷ Band Average Gross Income [$k]) × 1,000 (subject to RBNZ $0.1m / $1,000 band rounding)
records.hlf_interpretation: HLF market context: RBNZ's Borrower Gross Income (BGI) measures total application income (which for couples combines two salaries, and for investors includes existing salaries plus gross rental and other qualifying income).
records.methodology: RBNZ Table C41 publishes official total gross income ($m, rounded to $0.1m) and average gross income ($000, rounded to $1,000) within each TDTI band rather than a single all-bands average. HLF derives the overall mean by dividing total gross income summed across all reported TDTI bands by the implied number of applications (Band Total Income ÷ Band Average Income) summed across those bands.
records.citation: HLF Pulse, Home Loan Factory. "Average gross borrower income for approved first-home buyers vs property investors," September 2026. Derived by HLF from Reserve Bank of New Zealand — Residential mortgage borrower gross income (BGI) (Table C41). https://pulse-data.homeloanfactory.co.nz/borrower-income/ (checked 14 November 2026). CC BY 4.0.
records.summary_text: In September 2026, approved New Zealand first-home buyer mortgage applications averaged $144,232 in gross borrower income (ranging from $123,000 to $197,000 across DTI bands).

records.data_type: Officially reported RBNZ series & HLF-derived >6x DTI share

records.methodology: Derived from RBNZ Table C40 by summing first-home buyer lending commitments in bands above 6x TDTI (including unknown TDTI) and dividing by total first-home buyer commitments across all TDTI bands.
